detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The below text contains spoilers to the base game The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria™

Your story doesn’t end here, oh no…

The Dimrill Gate is open but what’s next for you, Dwarf? As Lord of Moria, it is now your responsibility to bring Khazad-dûm back to its former glory and repopulate it. That means only one thing - Durin’s folk are coming back to Moria!

In this expansion, NPCs join you and your Company to establish trade and help you rebuild Moria, while you embark on Expeditions to uncover even greater treasures and long-buried secrets…

KEY GAME FEATURES

  • Extend the Story - next chapter of your story with up to 20 additional hours of gameplay

  • NPCs are Here! Recruit NPCs to help you build, fight, mine, and more 

  • New Locations - explore outside the mountain for the first time, and uncover new secrets you previously overlooked within Moria

  • Trading - Get ready to trade Moria’s valuables for goods from beyond the Misty Mountains

  • Expeditions - New quests with unimaginable rewards are ready to challenge you and your companions

  • New dangers - With new locations come new dangers awaiting in the depths…
